name: EM FX Carry-to-Vol Ranking with VIX Regime
description: Ranks BRL, MXN, ZAR, and IDR by carry-to-volatility ratio, with a VIX regime filter (threshold = 20). Carry is implied from annualized rolling 63-day mean of daily FX returns (sign-flipped for long-EM convention). Volatility is 60-day realized vol. Outputs: (1) grouped bars comparing avg carry-to-vol in low vs high VIX regimes per currency, (2) current ranking snapshot, (3) summary table with carry, vol, ratio, and rank.
source:
# EM FX Carry-to-Vol Ranking
# Ranks BRL, MXN, ZAR, TRY, IDR by risk-adjusted carry (carry / realized vol)
# Carry = implied from annualized rolling FX returns (long-EM convention)
# Vol = 60-day realized volatility

# --- Data ---
src = market_data_source()()
close = src.c
ts = index().value

# VIX for regime filter
vix = common_indices(ticker=ReferenceIndex.VIX)()
vix_close = ffill(vix.c)
low_vix = is_valid(vix_close) and vix_close < 20.0
high_vix = is_valid(vix_close) and vix_close >= 20.0

# --- Implied Carry ---
# Daily return of USD/EM pair
daily_ret = returns(period=1)(close)

# Annualized carry proxy: 63-day MA of daily returns, annualized
# Sign-flipped: for USD/EM pairs, long EM = short the pair
# So positive carry = EM rate > US rate = USD/EM tends to drift up (EM depreciation)
# but carry trader earns the rate differential, so implied carry = -annualized_return
avg_daily_ret = ma(period=63, type=MAType.sma)(daily_ret)
implied_carry = avg_daily_ret * -252.0

# --- Realized Volatility (60-day) ---
# Close-to-close annualized vol
real_vol = basic_volatility(type=BasicVolatilityType.return_type, period=60)(close)

# --- Carry-to-Vol Ratio ---
# Guard against division by zero
carry_to_vol = where(is_valid(real_vol) and real_vol > 0.001, implied_carry / real_vol)

# --- Cross-Sectional Rank ---
ctv_rank = cs_rank(ascending=False)(carry_to_vol)

# --- VIX Regime Filtered Carry-to-Vol ---
ctv_low_vix = where(low_vix, carry_to_vol)
ctv_high_vix = where(high_vix, carry_to_vol)

# --- Output 1: Carry-to-Vol by VIX Regime (Does risk-adjusted carry differ in calm vs stressed markets?) ---
cs_bars(
    mode=CSBarMode.grouped,
    agg=AggregationType.Mean,
    title='Carry-to-Vol: Calm Markets (VIX<20) vs Stressed (VIX>=20)',
    category='EM Carry Ranking',
    data_labels=True,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    y_axis_label='Avg Carry / Vol',
    series_names=['VIX < 20', 'VIX >= 20'],
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='Zero')
    ]),
    order=0
)(values=(ctv_low_vix, ctv_high_vix))

# --- Output 2: Current Ranking Snapshot (Who leads today?) ---
cs_bars(
    mode=CSBarMode.simple,
    agg=AggregationType.Last,
    title='Current Carry-to-Vol Ranking',
    category='EM Carry Ranking',
    data_labels=True,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    sort_by_value=SortByValue.Descending,
    color_by_value=True,
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='Zero')
    ]),
    order=1
)(values=carry_to_vol)

# --- Output 3: Summary Table (Carry, Vol, Ratio for each currency) ---
cs_summary_table(
    title='EM FX Carry Components',
    agg=AggregationType.Last,
    category='EM Carry Ranking',
    order=2,
    schema=TableReportSchema(
        title='EM FX Carry Components',
        columns=[
            ColumnSpec(title='Implied Carry (Ann.)', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(title='60d Realized Vol', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(title='Carry / Vol', type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title='Rank', type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat, dp=0)
        ]
    )
)(implied_carry, real_vol, carry_to_vol, ctv_rank)

# --- Event Marker: Ranking Leader Changes ---
# Detect when a currency becomes the top-ranked (rank = 1)
is_top = ctv_rank == 1.0
was_not_top = (ctv_rank >> 1) != 1.0
became_leader = is_top and was_not_top

# Label for the event
leader_label = conditional_select(
    is_asset_ref(ticker='USDMXN')().result, "MXN",
    is_asset_ref(ticker='USDBRL')().result, "BRL",
    is_asset_ref(ticker='USDIDR')().result, "IDR",
    "ZAR"
)

event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        title='Carry Leader Change',
        icon=Icon.TrendingUpIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(title='New Leader', type=CardRenderType.TextFormat,
                       card_slot=CardSlot.PrimaryBadge),
            ColumnSpec(title='Carry/Vol', dp=2, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
                       card_slot=CardSlot.Hero),
            ColumnSpec(title='Implied Carry', dp=1, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
                       card_slot=CardSlot.Subtitle),
            ColumnSpec(table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False)
        ]
    )
)(leader_label, carry_to_vol, implied_carry, became_leader)
